# Radio Link Failure Prediction (Turkcell, ITU 2021)

Regional microwave radio-link KPIs with weather (met) tables for predicting radio link failures (target 'rlf' in rl-kpis). Highly imbalanced (~0.06% positive). Data is in RegionA.zip inside a .7z archive (6 TSVs: rl-kpis, rl-sites, distances, met-stations, met-real, met-forecast). ITU AI/ML in 5G Challenge 2021.
